ayahs.1: The Hour has drawn near, and the moon was split—a sign witnessed yet dismissed.
ayahs.2: Whenever they see an ayah, they turn away and say: The same old sorcery.
ayahs.3: They rejected the truth and followed their desires—and every matter will be settled.
ayahs.4: Stories of destroyed nations have already come to them as a sufficient deterrent.
ayahs.5: This Qur'an is profound wisdom, but warnings do them no good.
ayahs.6: So turn away from them, O Prophet. Wait for the Day when the caller will summon them to something horrifying.
ayahs.7: With eyes downcast they will emerge from the graves like swarming locusts,
ayahs.8: rushing toward the caller. Those who rejected the truth will cry: This is a hard Day!
ayahs.9: Before them the people of Noah denied the truth. They rejected Our servant, called him mad, and he was driven back.
ayahs.10: He cried to his Rabb: I am overcome—help me!
ayahs.11: So We opened the gates of the sky with pouring rain,
ayahs.12: and made the earth burst with springs until the waters met for a matter already decreed.
ayahs.13: We carried him on an ark of planks and nails,
ayahs.14: sailing under Our watchful eyes—a repayment for the one they had rejected.
ayahs.15: We left this as a sign. Is there anyone who will take heed?
ayahs.16: How terrible were My punishment and My warnings!
ayahs.17: We have made the Qur'an easy for dhikr—conscious remembrance. Is there anyone who will remember?
ayahs.18: 'Ad denied as well. How terrible were My punishment and My warnings!
ayahs.19: We sent against them a furious wind on a day of unrelenting misery,
ayahs.20: snatching people up and leaving them like uprooted palm trunks.
ayahs.21: How terrible were My punishment and My warnings!
ayahs.22: We have made the Qur'an easy for remembrance. Is there anyone who will remember?
ayahs.24: saying: Shall we follow a single man from among us? We would then be lost and mad.
ayahs.25: Was revelation sent down to him alone out of all of us? He is a lying braggart.
ayahs.26: They will soon know who the lying braggart is.
ayahs.27: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them and be patient.
ayahs.28: Tell them the water is to be shared between them and her, each with an appointed turn to drink.
ayahs.29: But they called their companion, and he took a sword and killed her.
ayahs.30: How terrible were My punishment and My warnings!
ayahs.31: We sent against them a single blast, and they were left like dry fence-builders' twigs.
ayahs.32: We have made the Qur'an easy for remembrance. Is there anyone who will remember?
ayahs.33: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
ayahs.34: We sent a storm of stones against them, except Lot's family—we saved them before dawn
ayahs.35: as a favour from Us. This is how We repay whoever shows shukr.
ayahs.36: He had warned them of Our punishment, but they doubted the warnings.
ayahs.37: They even demanded his guests from him, so We blinded their eyes. Taste My punishment and warnings!
ayahs.38: By early morning an unrelenting torment overwhelmed them.
ayahs.40: We have made the Qur'an easy for remembrance. Is there anyone who will remember?
ayahs.41: Warnings also came to the people of Pharaoh.
ayahs.42: They rejected all Our ayahs, so We seized them with the grip of the Almighty, All-Powerful.
ayahs.43: Are your deniers better than those destroyed nations? Or have you been granted immunity in the scriptures?
ayahs.44: Or do they say: We are a united front that will prevail?
ayahs.45: Their united front will be routed and turn to flee.
ayahs.46: Better yet—the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour will be most catastrophic and most bitter.
ayahs.47: The wicked are lost in error and heading for blazing Fire.
ayahs.48: On the Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces: Taste the touch of Hell!
ayahs.49: We created everything according to precise measure.
ayahs.50: Our command is only a single word, like the blink of an eye.
ayahs.51: We have already destroyed the likes of you. Is there anyone who will take heed?
ayahs.52: Everything they did is in their records.
ayahs.53: Every matter, small and large, is written down.
ayahs.54: The righteous will be amid Gardens and rivers,
ayahs.55: in the seat of honour, in the presence of the All-Powerful Sovereign.
